problem.md: The Work surface exposed only spacious List and Board layouts, navigated away for details, and remained visually empty in repositories without page contracts. It lacked a compact table, shared field hierarchy, context-preserving inspection, and explicit handling for unavailable metadata.

goal.md: Provide compact List, Table, and Kanban views over one validated contract projection, with shared filtering and an accessible right-side detail drawer. Preserve deterministic static HTML, file:// operation, no-JavaScript full-page links, light/dark themes, reduced motion, and readable 360 px layouts.

tasks.title: Derive bounded Work metadata from validated contracts without inventing unsupported values
Implement peer List, Table, and Kanban views with shared filtering
Implement hash-addressable accessible detail drawer and keyboard behavior
Add Jira-inspired design documentation and focused regression coverage
Pass the full release gate and merge the implementation into main
